_comment: PUBLIC keys only (base64, 32 bytes) of the system images; the private halves are their owner's. 'dev': signs local builds (a locked device refuses it); 'release': the developer's signing key; 'sender': the developer's X25519 key, the only one that can encrypt an image for a device; 'enc': the device's X25519 key (its private half is in the device's boot ROM / secure storage).
